{{Money|1,300}} (Group Bonus) |music-1 = Ambient''' [ |music-ingame-1 = Ambient''' |music-2 = '''Final Wave }} ==Description== '''Nil Zone II''' is the the map for the [[Halloween 2026 Live Events]]. Like other event maps, this map has a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with a varying amount of cash, based on the difficulty chosen. It had no unique rewards other than the [[Banned Crate]], which can only be gotten every 24 hours from triumphs. [[Logbooks]] and Tower XP gain are disabled on this map. You only got cash if an enemy was killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. Enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player did all the damage to an enemy, both players would receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal number, it got rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it was at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it was less than 0.5, it got rounded down. Logbooks are disabled on this map, meaning players cannot save enemies from there and later use in [[Sandbox Mode]]. ==Design & Path== '''Nil Zone II''' takes place on a desolate corrupted area in the middle of nowhere. It is made out of purple Roblox parts with studs and purple binary on them. This area is surrounded by multiple pillars, which either have moving orange cogs on them or giant hands. Behind the entrance, there is also a large tower placed on nothing with a cog at the front of it. The path starts and ends at a white portal. The map takes a short straight path which leads into two u-turns, ending with another short straight path that leads to the exit. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Nil Zone II}} ==Preset Loadouts== Each player was allowed to pick from one of three preset loadouts. Alongside these preset options, players could opt to use their current loadout as the first choice. However, if one's loadout contained no towers, this option would be unavailable. {{PresetLoadout |Name = Tactician |Description = A well-rounded and adaptable loadout. |SlotLink1 = Executioner |Icon1 = DefaultExecutioner0.png |SlotLink2 = Juggernaut |Icon2 = EvolvedJuggernautIcon.png |SlotLink3 = Pulse Trooper |Icon3 = DefaultPulseTrooper0.png |SlotLink4 = Crook Boss |Icon4 = CBRCBossIcon.png |SlotLink5 = DJ Booth |Icon5 = DefaultDJBoothIconAug2024.png }} {{PresetLoadout |Name = Crowd Control |Description = A class that focuses on debuffing and AOE damage. |SlotLink1 = Kingpin |Icon1 = DefaultKingpin0.png |SlotLink2 = Electroshocker |Icon2 = DefaultElectroshockerIcon2.png |SlotLink3 = Rocketeer |Icon3 = RocketeerIcon2025.png |SlotLink4 = Saboteur |Icon4 = SaboteurIcon.png |SlotLink5 = Commander |Icon5 = Commandernew.png }} {{PresetLoadout |Name = Specialist |Description = A class that uses unique towers that excel at specific roles. |SlotLink1 = Enforcer |Icon1 = DefaultEnforcer0.png |SlotLink2 = Engineer |Icon2 = EngineerIcon.png |SlotLink3 = Golden Demoman |Icon3 = GoldenDemoman0.png |SlotLink4 = Medic |Icon4 = DefaultMedicIconAug25.png |SlotLink5 = Mercenary Base |Icon5 = DefaultMercenaryBaseIcon.png }} ==Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts were additive. ===Badges=== There was also a [[Badges|badge]] which could be obtained when playing this map: {{Badge |title = Live Event 9/25 |image = LiveEvent925Badge.png |obtainable = Yes }} ==Wave Structure== '''Bolded''' names indicate an enemy type's debut.

==Strategy== *Splash towers capable of dealing with crowd control such as [[Demoman]], [[Rocketeer]], and [[Mortar]] can be quite useful given the path layout and the considerably high health of enemies in the early waves. **Alternatively, towers that can stun enemies such as [[Electroshocker]] and [[Pulse Trooper]] are also valuable. *Having two players with [[DJ Booth]], although not required, is recommended given the large amounts of enemies that may cluster through those two paths connected to each other. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| }} ==Trivia== *'''Nil Zone II''' is the first event map to utilize Evolved towers in the preset loadouts. *'''Nil Zone II''' is nearly identical to that of [[Nil Zone]]—especially with its pathway—except that the path was slightly adjusted to go through other paths which the first one did not apply, and that it is also more visible than [[Nil Zone]]. **Additionally, the map was redesigned from [[Nil Zone]] to more closely match the Halloween 2026 event rather than the [[Null & Void Event]]. ==Update History== *'''25 September 2026''' - [[v2.11.0|v2.11.2]] **'''Nil Zone II''' added. {{MapNavBox}}
